slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
无尽宇宙中心。
诸天万域。
天域。
长生仙族姜家，乃是承接远古仙道无数纪元，极尽辉煌的无上仙族。
红帝城。
一座巍峨宫殿内，雕梁画栋，富丽堂皇。
首座之上。
一位身披金丝凤袍，美艳如仙的女人慵懒地倚靠在宝座上，气质雍容华贵，举手投足间尽显风华。
“夜儿，太衍圣地的圣女近日觉醒了太阴圣体，本是说今日送到，却临时传来消息，那小圣女要推迟些时日，说是与人有三年之约…”
“娘是觉着，这毕竟是双方提前订好的事，怎可轻易推迟？这多少有点不识抬举了。”
“要不把太衍圣地灭了，再把云雅曼抓来，给你做暖床侍女，如何？”
苏红夜身旁，坐着一位少年。
身穿黑色锦服，绣有金丝龙纹。
眼似星辰，立体的五官勾画出完美的轮廓，一头银色长发如瀑布般倾泻而下，浑身散发着清逸如仙的气质。
姜夜听后神色微敛，眸光微动。
几息之间，万千念头在脑海中闪过。
作为胎穿大军的一员，他的投胎功夫简直炉火纯青。
姜夜，出生便是长生仙族姜家的神子，天生贵胄，背景通天。
诞生之日，整个天域内天降瑞音，龙凤虚影环绕红帝城，天地变色，无数异象在天际显现，金光照耀。
当日便被探查出，拥有永恒仙体。

天生无垢，自主吸收天地灵气炼化，修炼速度奇快，同时内蕴神纹可增强自身神通威力。
自此，姜夜便过上了锦衣玉食的奢靡日子，饮用的是纯天然灵液，吃的是龙肝凤髓，还给他配了数十个用于双修的侍女，全都是拥有特殊体质的绝色佳人。
早早便破了身，整天骄奢淫逸。
可能是前世被卷麻了。
所以姜夜三天打鱼两天晒网，同时还不思进取，只想着做躺平的仙二代。
谁敢造次，直接就摇人。
父母与家中老祖更是护犊子，生怕他受了半点委屈。
但永恒仙体着实变态，哪怕是这种情况下，姜夜的修炼速度亦是惊人。
骨龄十七，已成不灭境九重。
不过中间出现了一些小插曲。
黑暗动乱爆发，域外邪魔入侵诸天万域。
其母苏红夜将他封入族内神源中，直至一个月前才重新解封。
那场劫难，被后人称为黑暗纪元。
整整持续了近万年的战争。
无数修士血洒乱世，无数大帝强者纷纷陨落，最终只幸存十余位。
之后又过了二十万年的黑暗纪元，天道残缺，灵气稀薄，无人成就大帝。
而仅存的这些大帝。
但凡是与域外邪魔战斗过，无一例外，全都被邪魔炁气污染过，神魂被严重侵蚀，战力十不存一，随时间流逝愈发严重。
content_en:
The center of the endless universe.
All heavens and all realms.
Heavenly domain.
The Jiang family of the Immortal Immortal Clan is the supreme immortal clan that has inherited the ancient Immortal Way for countless epochs and has been extremely glorious.
Red Emperor City.
In a majestic palace, there are carved beams and painted buildings, which are magnificent.
On top of the throne.
A beautiful woman wearing a gold silk phoenix robe leaned lazily on the throne. Her temperament was graceful and luxurious, and her every move showed elegance.
"Ye'er, the Saint of Taiyan Holy Land recently awakened the Taiyin Holy Body. It was originally said that it would be delivered today, but unexpected news came that the little Saint would postpone it for a while, saying that she had a three-year appointment with someone..."
"Mom, I feel that after all, this is a matter agreed by both parties in advance, how can it be postponed so easily? This is somewhat disrespectful."
"How about destroying the Taiyan Holy Land, and then capturing Yun Yaman to be your bed-warming maid?"
Next to Su Hongye, a young man sat.
Wearing black brocade clothes, embroidered with gold dragon patterns.
His eyes are like stars, his three-dimensional facial features outline a perfect outline, his long silver hair pours down like a waterfall, and his whole body exudes an elegant and fairy-like temperament.
After hearing this, Jiang Ye's expression dimmed slightly and his eyes moved slightly.
Within a few breaths, thousands of thoughts flashed through my mind.
As a member of the army of reincarnation, his reincarnation skills are extremely proficient.
Jiang Ye was born as the divine son of the Jiang family of the Immortal Immortal Clan. He was born a nobleman and had a great background.
On the day of his birth, auspicious sounds descended from the sky throughout the entire heaven, phantoms of dragons and phoenixes surrounded the Red Emperor City, the color of the heaven and earth changed, countless visions appeared in the sky, and golden light shone.
It was discovered that day that he had an eternal immortal body.
Born without dirt, he can independently absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth for refining, and his cultivation speed is extremely fast. At the same time, he has divine patterns that can enhance his own magical power.
From then on, Jiang Ye lived a luxurious life with fine clothes and fine food. He drank pure natural spiritual liquid, ate dragon liver and phoenix marrow, and was assigned dozens of maids for dual cultivation, all of whom were stunning beauties with special physiques.
He lost his virginity early and lived in arrogance and licentiousness all day long.
Maybe it was because I was hooked in a previous life.
So Jiang Ye spent three days fishing and two days drying the net. At the same time, he didn't want to make progress. He just wanted to be a second-generation immortal who lay flat.
Anyone who dares to make a mistake will be immediately shaken.
His parents and ancestors were even more protective of him, fearing that he would be wronged in the slightest.
But the Eternal Immortal Body is really abnormal. Even under this situation, Jiang Ye's cultivation speed is astonishing.
The bone age is seventeen, and he has reached the ninth level of immortality.
But there were some hiccups in the middle.
Dark turmoil breaks out, and evil spirits from outside the world invade all heavens and realms.
His mother, Su Hongye, sealed him into the clan's divine source, and she did not unblock him again until a month ago.
That disaster was called the Dark Age by later generations.
The war lasted for nearly ten thousand years.
The blood of countless monks spilled in the troubled times, and countless powerful emperors fell one after another. In the end, only a dozen or so survived.
After that, another 200,000 years of the Dark Age passed. The way of heaven was incomplete, the spiritual energy was thin, and no one became an emperor.
And these are the only remaining great emperors.
Anyone who has fought against demons outside the territory, without exception, has been contaminated by the demon's Qi, their souls have been severely eroded, and their combat power has been reduced to ten percent, which has become more and more serious as time goes by.
